detail.longDescription: Two years ago, I bought a new SUV. Before setting foot in the dealership, I spent a while customizing it online. I picked the flashiest trim and added a tow package. The site informed me that the tow package needed the bigger engine, the bigger engine needed the upgraded brakes, and my total was now $8,000 over a number that was already out of my range to begin with.
